diagnosis: Escaping is implemented in regex-syntax/src/lib.rs::escape_into, which prefixes each regex meta character with one backslash and preserves UTF-8 bytes. regex-syntax::escape allocates a String and delegates to escape_into; the top-level regex crate exposes escape as a direct wrapper. Add allocation-free public escape_len functions in those two lib.rs files, computing text.len() plus the count of escaped chars. This preserves results and leaves existing escape/escape_into behavior unchanged; the existing reserve(text.len()) gives at most one growth allocation for nonempty input and no allocation for empty input. Proposed review also adds focused length invariants for meta, empty, and multibyte input. Uncertainty: allocation behavior is inferred from the existing reserve path and was not benchmark-verified in discovery.
